{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode = Basketball |year = 2016–17 |team = Miami RedHawks |image = Miami Redhawks logo.svg |image_size = 150 |conference = Mid-American Conference |division = East Division |short_conf = MAC |CoachRank = |APRank = |record = 11–21 |conf_record = 4–14 |head_coach = [[John Cooper (basketball)|John Cooper]] |hc_year = 5th |asst_coach1 = [[Rick Duckett]] |asst_coach2 = Sheldon Everett |asst_coach3 = Trey Meyer |asst_coach4 = |stadium = [[Millett Hall]] |champion = |bowl = |bowl_result = }} {{2016–17 Mid-American Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2016–17 Miami RedHawks men's basketball team''' represented [[Miami University]] during the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The RedHawks, led by fifth-year head coach [[John Cooper (basketball)|John Cooper]], played their home games at [[Millett Hall]], as members of the East Division of the [[Mid-American Conference]]. They finished the season 11–21, 4–14 in MAC play to finish in last place. As the No. 12 seed in the [[2017 MAC men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]], they lost in the first round to [[2016-17 Western Michigan Broncos men's basketball team|Western Michigan]]. Head coach John Cooper was fired on March 10, 2017 after five seasons at Miami.{{cite news|url=http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/18875332/john-cooper-fired-miami-ohio-head-coach|title=John Cooper fired as Miami (Ohio) head coach|work=ESPN.com|first=Jeff|last=Goodman|date=March 10, 2017|accessdate=July 18, 2017}} [[Purdue Boilermakers men's basketball|Purdue]] associate head coach [[Jack Owens (basketball)|Jack Owens]] was named the new head coach on March 29.{{cite news|url=http://www.cincinnati.com/story/sports/college/miami-university/2017/03/29/report-redhawks-hire-purdues-jack-owens-basketball-head-coach/99779994/|title=RedHawks hire Purdue's Jack Owens as basketball head coach|newspaper=cincinnati.com|first=Dave|last=Clark|date=March 29, 2017|accessdate=July 18, 2017}} ==Previous season== The [[2015–16 Miami RedHawks men's basketball team|RedHawks]] finished the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] 13–20, 6–12 in MAC play to finish in fifth place in the East Division.
